name: Ramakanta Samantaray/ ରମାକାନ୍ତ ସାମନ୍ତରାୟ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Ramakanta Samantaray’s Odia poem “ବାହାରୁ ଭିତରକୁ” appears in Kabita Live’s July 2024 edition. It moves between the world seen from a room and the world the imagination can create within it.

The speaker watches the sky through changing colours, stars, birds and dreams. When a new wall blocks that view, drawing becomes a way to recover it: the wall turns into an imagined sky, holding the face of a beloved. The poem makes an obstruction into a surface for memory and invention.
